# @zakkster/lite-media

> Reactive media & preference signals built on @zakkster/lite-signal.
> Wraps window.matchMedia in Signal<boolean>; page-lifetime memoization by
> exact query string; zero-GC steady state; honest scope (module-global,
> not per-request). One runtime dep: @zakkster/lite-signal. ESM-only. MIT.
> v1.0.0 ships Engine A (viewport & preferences).

## Design in one line

JS never evaluates a query. The browser evaluates via matchMedia; lite-media
observes the verdict and pushes a boolean into the lite-signal graph.

Consequences:
- Correctness for free: range syntax, em resolved against font-size, dvh,
  future media features — the browser handles them. No JS parser to maintain.
- Zero-GC steady state: a change event runs one hoisted handler that does one
  sig.set(e.matches). lite-signal's Object.is equality drops redundant events.
  No timers, no debounce, no schedulers.

## Scope note

The memoization cache is module-global — one signal per unique query string,
shared across the process. Right for a page or a Twitch overlay. Wrong for a
request-per-render server: ssrDefault is a process-wide constant, per-request
values are not supported in v1.0.0. A createMedia() factory for scoped
instances is on the v1.1.0 roadmap if consumer demand shows up.

## Rejected alternative (documented for the roadmap ledger)

Regex-parsing queries in JS and evaluating them against clientWidth was
considered and rejected. Failures: cannot stay correct with the CSS spec;
misses decimals and range syntax; measures the wrong box (padding vs content);
setTimeout debouncing adds allocation + latency where ResizeObserver already
frame-coalesces. The correct mechanism is the browser's matchMedia (engine A,
v1.0.0) and — for containers — an injected @container rule + transitionrun on
a zero-size sentinel (engine B, v1.1.0). See ROADMAP for the container spec.

## Public API (v1.0.0)

    import { signal, effect } from "@zakkster/lite-signal";
    import {
        media, configure, stats,
        reducedMotion, darkScheme, hoverCapable, coarsePointer,
        forcedColors, moreContrast, reducedData, reducedTransparency,
    } from "@zakkster/lite-media";

### media(query: string): MediaSignal

Memoized reactive boolean for a CSS media query. Same query string ⇒ same
signal instance. Signal has (): boolean tracked read, .peek(): boolean
untracked read, .subscribe(fn): dispose. .set / .update are hidden by the
TypeScript declaration (they exist at runtime — see Read-only note below).

Throws Error if no matchMedia is available and no ssrDefault was configured.
Throws TypeError if a configured factory returns a non-MQL-shaped object.

Failed materialization does NOT engage the lock. The caller can configure()
and retry.

### configure(options): void

Test / SSR seam. Must be called before the first SUCCESSFUL media() call.

    options.matchMedia — (query: string) => MediaQueryList-shaped
                         Must be a function; non-function throws TypeError.
                         Falls through to globalThis.matchMedia when unset.
    options.ssrDefault — boolean returned when no matchMedia is resolvable.
                         Non-boolean (including undefined) is a no-op — does
                         NOT un-set a previously configured default.

Silently ignores null, undefined, non-object input. Multiple pre-lock calls
compose (later valid keys override earlier ones). Reconfiguration after a
successful materialization throws Error.

### Preference shortcuts

Each is () => MediaSignal, delegating to media() with a fixed query string.
Hoist once per component, read call-style:

    const rm = reducedMotion();
    effect(() => { if (!rm()) startAnimation(); });

    reducedMotion       — (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)
    darkScheme          — (prefers-color-scheme: dark)
    hoverCapable        — (hover: hover)
    coarsePointer       — (pointer: coarse)
    forcedColors        — (forced-colors: active)
    moreContrast        — (prefers-contrast: more)
    reducedData         — (prefers-reduced-data: reduce)
    reducedTransparency — (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce)

Function form (not module-level pre-created signals) is deliberate: creating
signals at import time would require globalThis.matchMedia at module load,
which breaks SSR-honest defaults. The hoist step costs one line and buys
clean off-DOM semantics.

Deferred to later releases: standaloneDisplay (PWA display-mode; belongs in
a PWA-shell package) and highDynamicRange (dynamic-range; naturally owned by
lite-color-engine / lite-hueforge).

### stats(): Stats

Cheap allocation-light snapshot for demos, perf overlays, and test asserts.

    watched     — number of memoized signals in the cache
    configured  — whether configure() explicitly set matchMedia or ssrDefault
                  (does NOT count fallback to native globalThis.matchMedia)
    locked      — whether a successful materialization has happened

### __resetForTests(): void

@internal — test-only escape hatch. NOT part of the semver contract. Clears
the cache, configured factory, ssrDefault, lock, AND the cached bound native
matchMedia in one call.

## Types

    interface MediaSignal {
        (): boolean;                                       // tracked read
        peek(): boolean;                                   // untracked read
        subscribe(fn: (v: boolean) => void): () => void;   // dispose
    }

    interface ConfigureOptions {
        matchMedia?: (query: string) => MockMediaQueryList;
        ssrDefault?: boolean;
    }

    interface MockMediaQueryList {
        matches: boolean;
        addEventListener(
            type: "change",
            handler: (event: { matches: boolean }) => void
        ): void;
    }

    interface Stats { watched: number; configured: boolean; locked: boolean; }

## Read-only by convention

MediaSignal in the .d.ts hides .set / .update. At runtime the returned object
is still a lite-signal Signal, so a JS consumer or a TS cast can write to it.
Doing so permanently desyncs the shared signal from the browser until the
next real `change` event. If you need write access, wrap in a computed() you
own instead of writing through the shared signal.

## Memoization contract

media() memoizes by exact string match, for the lifetime of the module (no
eviction, no dispose). Query strings MUST come from a bounded static set —
interned literals, module-level constants, or a finite table of known
breakpoints. Building queries from unbounded input leaks signals AND live
change listeners:

    // WRONG — leaks per unique width
    for (let w = 300; w < 1300; w++) media(`(max-width: ${w}px)`);

Bucket via Math.floor to a fixed step, or drop out of memoization for one-offs.

## Allocation profile

    Op                                   | Allocations
    ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------
    media(query) cache hit               | 0 hot-path (Map lookup)
    media(query) cache miss (mock)       | 1 signal + 1 handler + 1 MQL
    media(query) cache miss (native, 1st)| 1 signal + 1 handler + 1 MQL + 1 bound-native fn
    media(query) cache miss (native, ≥2) | 1 signal + 1 handler + 1 MQL (bind cached)
    Signal read (s())                    | 0
    change event → sig.set               | 0
    Redundant event (same value)         | 0 (Object.is dedup in lite-signal)
    Preference shortcut call             | 0 (delegates to media() cache)

The bound globalThis.matchMedia is allocated once per process. Cost scales
with verdict flips, not with browser events.

## When to use / not use

USE for:
- Twitch overlays and embedded widgets where every ms matters.
- Any consumer that would otherwise wire its own matchMedia listener per
  component (memoization is the point).
- Preference-gated code paths (reduced-motion, forced-colors, dark scheme).
- Test suites that need honest boolean semantics via a mock.

DO NOT USE for:
- Container-relative queries in v1.0.0 (media() will accept them but the
  browser can't resolve cqw/cqi against the document, so signals stay false).
  containerMedia() ships in v1.1.0 — see ROADMAP.
- Style queries via style(--var: value) in v1.0.0 (same reason).
- Pure feature detection (matchMedia is the wrong tool; use @supports).
- Per-request SSR with request-specific defaults — module-global memoization
  means the first request wins for the whole process. Emit a pessimistic
  default and hydrate on the client.
- Unbounded/dynamic query strings (see Memoization contract).

## SSR / testing

Server-side or Node: two options.

1) Configure a process-wide default (constant across all requests):

    configure({ ssrDefault: false });
    const s = media("(any)");   // returns false without a browser

2) Provide a mock factory:

    configure({
        matchMedia: (query) => ({
            matches: false,
            addEventListener() { /* no-op or wire to a test dispatcher */ },
        }),
    });

Tests should call __resetForTests() in beforeEach to clear the module-global
state. Node's --test runs each file in its own subprocess by default, so
cross-file isolation is free; within-file isolation is one line.

## Roadmap

- 1.0.0 — Engine A (this release): media(), 8 preferences, configure, stats.
- 1.1.0 — Engine B: containerMedia(el, query) via injected @container rules +
          transitionrun on a zero-size sentinel with a registered
          <custom-ident> property. Native verdicts (range syntax, cqw,
          style()) — zero JS query parsing. Also under consideration:
          createMedia({ matchMedia, ssrDefault }) factory for scoped
          instances (unblocks per-request SSR).
- 1.2.0 — breakpoints({ sm, md, lg }) interned-token computed; reconsider
          standaloneDisplay / highDynamicRange based on consumer demand.
- 1.3.0 — Shadow DOM multi-root support for engine B; iframe / Twitch
          panel-mode verification pass.
- 1.4.0 — Ecosystem wiring: lite-ambient-fx & lite-scratch-fx consume
          reducedMotion via watchEffect + onCleanup rAF gate; lite-hueforge
          pairs moreContrast / forcedColors with APCA role-floor selection.

Watchlist: CSSWG #6205 (native Element.matchContainer). If it ships, engine B
collapses to a feature-detected bridge — signal-graph surface unchanged.

## File layout

    Media.js       — single-file ESM implementation
    Media.d.ts     — TypeScript declarations (MediaSignal narrows Signal<boolean>)
    test/01-media.test.mjs      — memoization, updates, preferences (node:test)
    test/02-configure.test.mjs  — mock seam, SSR default, lock semantics, validation
    test/03-zero-gc.test.mjs    — heap-delta guard (--expose-gc), timer-count guard
    README.md, llms.txt, LICENSE.txt, CHANGELOG.md

## Install

    npm install @zakkster/lite-media @zakkster/lite-signal
